data_scope: Nominal Higgs signal MC (ggH, VBF, WH, ZH, ggZH, ttH, tH) and data only; Sherpa diphoton continuum MC and any other non-nominal-Higgs MC samples are excluded from this analysis (see input_data_contract.json).
blinding_policy: Observed TI data in the 125+/-2 GeV signal window is never inspected, counted, summed, or plotted anywhere in this pipeline. A wider 120-130 GeV display-blind window is additionally applied to TI data in control-shape plots only; NTI data is never blinded.
